sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.423 of 2023, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Behta Gokul, District Hardoi.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant around five years ago.
The post-mortem report on record indicates the cause of death as ante mortem hanging.
No visible injury apart from the ligature mark is seen over the body.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: 5. Considering the fact that the applicant is mother-in-law and there is no allegation that soon before the death the victim was harassed physically or mentally at the instance of the applicant coupled with the fact that the applicant is aged about 60 years and has no criminal history, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Smt. Kamla Devi be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on her furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
